description: This file contains shell functions for managing firmware upgrades for Linksys devices, including determining the target firmware partition, verifying factory images, and performing platform-specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the appropriate firmware partition to upgrade based on current environment variables and system state.

methods.name: linksys_is_factory_image
methods.description: Verifies if a given firmware image matches the device's footer signature and board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade process, handling different firmware formats and ensuring proper update procedures.
